title: Average power usage effectiveness reported to the Uptime Institute, 2007–2025
description: Bar chart of the weighted average annual PUE that operators reported in the Uptime Institute's surveys, on an axis starting at 1.0, the ideal: 2.50 in 2007, 1.98 in 2011, 1.65 in 2014, 1.58 in 2018, 1.67 in 2019, 1.59 in 2020, 1.57 in 2021, 1.55 in 2022, 1.58 in 2023, 1.56 in 2024 and 1.54 in 2025 (681 operators). Data: Uptime Institute Global Data Center Survey 2025, figure 2.
heading: AVERAGE PUE REPORTED BY OPERATORS · 1.0 IS NO OVERHEAD
